things.name: the Gebel el-Silsila sandstone quarries
things.who: the main sandstone source for Theban temples, worked from the Middle Kingdom through the New Kingdom and again in Ptolemaic and Roman times (dates approximate)

things.name: the Colossi of Memnon
things.who: quartzite statues of Amenhotep III, about 700 to 720 tonnes each with base, probably from Gebel el-Ahmar

things.name: the Djehutihotep sledge painting
things.who: a tomb painting of a colossal statue (13 cubits, quoted at about 58 tonnes) hauled by 172 men, with sand being wetted

things.name: Merer's diary from Wadi al-Jarf
things.who: a logbook of a crew shipping Tura limestone for Khufu's pyramid

things.name: the wet-sand sledge study
things.who: by Fall, Bonn and colleagues in Physical Review Letters, showing correctly wetted sand halves the pulling force

things.name: Houdin's internal ramp theory
things.who: by the architect Jean-Pierre Houdin, for how the Great Pyramid was built

things.name: the Hatnub ramp discovery
things.who: announced by a joint IFAO and University of Liverpool mission: a ramp with post holes at an alabaster quarry, dated to Khufu's reign, slope 20 per cent or more

things.name: Engelbach's study of the Aswan obelisk
things.who: the standard measured account of the Unfinished Obelisk, which left its date open

things.name: the brickmaking scene in the tomb of Rekhmire
things.who: a tomb painting showing mud bricks being made and laid

things.name: the Turin plan of the tomb of Ramesses IV
things.who: a scale plan on papyrus with measurements (date approximate, from general knowledge)

things.name: the spread of iron tools in Egypt
things.who: iron objects increased from the late New Kingdom and were as common as bronze by the Twenty-sixth Dynasty; quarry tools only changed to iron near the end of the Late Period

people.name: Reginald Engelbach
people.who: an English Egyptologist who studied the Unfinished Obelisk and wrote on ancient building methods
events: co-wrote Ancient Egyptian Construction and Architecture

people.name: Somers Clarke
people.who: an English architect and Egyptologist, co-author of the classic book on Egyptian construction
events: died before his book with Engelbach on Egyptian construction appeared, in 1930

people.name: Dieter Arnold
people.who: a German Egyptologist and architect whose Building in Egypt is the standard work on stone masonry
events: published Building in Egypt: Pharaonic Stone Masonry

people.name: Yannis Gourdon
people.who: a French Egyptologist at IFAO who led the Hatnub quarry work
events: announced the Hatnub ramp and post holes

people.name: Flinders Petrie
people.who: the English archaeologist who surveyed Giza in 1880 to 1882 and proposed jewelled saw teeth
events: published The Pyramids and Temples of Gizeh
